$comment: Copy to brand.json in your working directory (or point the agent at any path). Missing keys fall back to the Salesforce palette. accents[] replaces the classification palette IN ORDER: [0] primary/core, [1] data, [2] integration, [3] engagement, [4] success, [5] warning. Each accent needs a light fill and a solid stroke of the same hue. Notation (ERD crow's feet, BPMN shapes) never changes with brand.
